name: Traffic light skips the yellow state
modeled_on: A state machine's transition table drops a state (green -> red, skipping yellow). Real-world analogue: a workflow/order-state machine where one transition edge was wired to the wrong destination.
hidden_bug: TrafficLight.next() moves directly from green to red, skipping the yellow state that the protocol requires.
expected_behavior: The light must cycle green -> yellow -> red -> green.
ground_truth: Transition from green to yellow (adding the missing state) before red.

expected_patch.description: route green -> yellow instead of green -> red
